mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video_media_metadata (video_id, duration_seconds, width, height, video_codec, has_audio, audio_codec, probe_json, probed_at) VALUES (#{videoId}, #{durationSeconds}, #{width}, #{height}, #{videoCodec}, #{hasAudio}, #{audioCodec,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{probeJson}, #{probedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE duration_seconds = #{durationSeconds}, width = #{width}, height = #{height}, video_codec = #{videoCodec}, has_audio = #{hasAudio}, audio_codec = #{audioCodec,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, probe_json = #{probeJson}, probed_at = #{probedAt}
mapper.select: SELECT video_id, duration_seconds, width, height, video_codec, has_audio, audio_codec, probe_json, probed_at FROM video_media_metadata WHERE video_id = #{videoId}
